content: «Haysso asa nawu! Urqqafe medhettida issi xuube ekkada ne sinththan woththa; histtada Yerusalaame misle iza bolla ooththa.
Histtada wottadaray giddoththiza mala izo giddoththa; miixa izin giigsa; biitta shiishsha doora; ola wosanata izi yuushon giigsa; gimbeza laalliza duruma izi yuushon waaxa.
Qasse birata bashe ekkada neeppenne katamaappe giddon birata gimbe mala essa. Ne sinththaa izikko zaarada dereqa; iza doodettidaaro gidana; nekka izo dooddana. Hessika Isra7eele asaas malata gidana.
«Tani Isra7eele keeththaa murizayssas malata gidana mala neni hadirsa millen ichcha; neni hadirsa millen ichchida wodeta ubbaan Isra7eele keeththa bala mala gidana mala bessana.
Isra7eele keeththay ba balan waani qaxxayettanaakko ne bessana mala ta nees 390 gallassata immadis; issi issi gallassay istti qaxxayettana issi issi layth bessees.
«Hessafe guye neni ushachcha millen 40 gallas ichcha; hessi Yuhuda asay ba balan waani qaxxayettanaakko bessiza malata gidana; issi issi gallassay istti qaxxayettana issi issi layth bessees.
Ne sinth Yerusalaame doodeteththaako zaarada dereqa; ne kushe denththada mandashe tinbite izi bolla yoota.
He doodeteththaa aginay wurana gakkanaas ne mille shirontta mala ta nena wodoron qachchana.
«Ha7i neni gisttenne bangga, ba7elanne misira, malidonne murqqa ekkada oton woththa; izappe kaththa ma; histtada neni hadirsa millen ichcha diza 390 gallassatan maana.
Hach hach ne maana kaththaa geeddara woththa; iza woden woden issi zolla ma.
Ne uyana haaththaaka makka woththa; hessa iza woden woden nam7u kubbaya uya.
He walakettida kaththaa ekkada deraa sinththan bangga ukeththa mala shi7a kefen uukkada ma.»
GODAYKKA, «Hessa mala hanotan Isra7eele asay tani istta laallana kawoteththata giddon istti tuna kath maanayssas malata» gides.

Histtiin tani zaarada, «Hay! Ubbaa Haariza GODAWU! Mulekka ta hessa malan tuna erikke; tani yelagateththafe doommada bawuta woykko do7ay wodhidayssa ma erikke; tunida ashoykka ta doonaakko shiiqi erenna» gadis.
Izikka tana, «Ero lo7o, shi7a kefen uukkizayssa aggada osha kefen uukka» gides.
Qasseka GODAY tana, «Haysso asa nawu! Akeeka; tani Yerusalaames kaththi yizasota duuththana hanays; asay kaththa hirgishe makan maana; haaththaaka yayyishe guuththara uyana.
Hessan isttas diza kaththinne haaththi paccana; issoy issaa be7ishe col7u gaana; istti bantta nagara gaason gilqi dhayana.
